images.heroAlt: Auto electrician checking a car engine bay

servicesSub: From a flat battery to a fault nobody else could find, we track down the cause and fix it properly.

services.title: Fault finding & diagnostics
services.short: Warning lights, dead circuits and intermittent faults tracked down quickly.
services.long: Electrical faults can be frustrating to chase. We test the circuit, find the real cause and fix it, rather than swapping parts and hoping for the best.

services.title: Mobile call-outs
services.short: Stuck and can't get to a workshop? We can come to you.
services.long: When the car won't start or a fault has left you stranded, call us. Many jobs can be diagnosed and fixed where the vehicle is sitting.
points: Fixed on the spot where possible
Just ring and explain the problem

services.title: Batteries, starting & charging
services.short: No-starts, flat batteries and charging problems checked and fixed.
services.long: If your vehicle is slow to crank, keeps going flat or isn't charging, we test the battery, alternator and starter system to find out why.

services.title: Caravan & 4WD electrics
services.short: Wiring, lighting and power for caravans, campers and touring rigs.
services.long: Heading up the coast or out west? We help sort the wiring, lighting and power problems that crop up on caravans, campers and touring 4WDs.
points: Faults found before you hit the road
